confidence_notes: Holistic July 2026 estimate from general knowledge and regional patterns; no live listings, menus, or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately reliable; accommodation (summer hotel and hostel rates) and drinks are least certain. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against the beer anchor (cocktail about 2.3x beer, wine about 1.1x beer) because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX figure is the 14 Oct 2026 RBA table value as returned by search, not re-opened on the live page; cached RBA pages in search differed in recency.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: mid-budget Central and Southeast European capitals with similar tourism demand, such as Sofia and Bucharest for restaurant and drink levels, with accommodation set nearer regional summer hotel rates. No single comparable city was matched exactly.
